snippet.title: Paper Craft - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Explore a crafted world in VR in Paper Craft. Check out the Paper Craft trailer for this game, where you can create and share your own levels. Paper Craft will be available on Steam and Meta Quest in fall 2025.
